title: Passive double pendulum
objective: Passive double pendulum: bounded energy error and agreement with a high-accuracy reference over a short horizon

primary_metric.name: max absolute angle error vs reference (rad)
primary_metric.definition: max over samples to 2 s of |phi_sim - phi_ref| for both absolute angles; plus energy relative drift

references: Textbook double-pendulum equations (point masses, massless rods)
model_assumptions: two point masses on massless rods; MuJoCo's second hinge angle is relative to the first, so phi1 = q1 and phi2 = q1 + q2; the reference is an independent pure-Python RK4 at 0.01 ms frozen in referee/ with its own convergence test.

variants.task: Equal masses and lengths, released at 0.8 and 1.2 rad. MuJoCo's second angle is relative (q2 = phi2 - phi1).
Masses 1 and 2 kg, lengths 1.0 and 0.6 m, released at 1.5 and 0.5 rad. MuJoCo's second angle is relative (q2 = phi2 - phi1).
Masses 2 and 1 kg, lengths 0.7 and 1.0 m, released at -0.5 and 2.0 rad. MuJoCo's second angle is relative (q2 = phi2 - phi1).
Negative control: gravity off, so the pendulum stays frozen.

grading: referee/criteria.json via oracle.py (stdlib only, run in a separate isolated interpreter)
